bias.en: Bearish · bounce back above the 5-day, capped near $142.7
bias.zh: 看空 · 反弹重回 5 日均线上方，$142.7 附近受阻

read.en: SpaceX rose 3.6% on Nov 3 to $141.31, trading between $137.56 and $142.73. It is just above the falling 5-day ($140.3) and below the falling 10-day ($144.9) and 30-day ($151.4) averages and the 100-day ($145.6); there is no 200-day yet. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($159.82), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月3日上涨 3.6%，收于 $141.31，盘中区间 $137.56–142.73。股价略高于下行的 5 日均线（$140.3），并低于下行的 10 日（$144.9）和 30 日均线（$151.4）以及 100 日均线（$145.6）；尚无 200 日均线。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$159.82），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The close moved above the 5-day ($140.3) and the Oct 15 low ($140.66), but the $142.73 high stalled just over the Nov 2 high. Resistance is $142.1–142.7 (Oct 28 low, Nov 2 and 3 highs), then $144.9–145.6 (10 and 100-day, Oct 29 high) and $151.4 (30-day). Support is $140.3–140.7, then $134–134.5 and $130.2–130.4. A close above $142.7 would target $145–145.6; below $140.3, $134–134.5.

r.en: Oct 28 low $142.13; Nov 2 high $142.05; Nov 3 high $142.73
